searchSpace.note: D10: 6 candidates, no clone rule. Clones stay a diagnostic and the clone-first baseline.

tier2.text: A matched or new production function intersecting the hunk has cyclomatic delta >= T (input: HunkMetrics.maxPositiveDelta).
A changed catch clause in a production file intersecting the hunk is catch_may_swallow (input: HunkMetrics.catchMaySwallow).
A changed production function intersecting the hunk has >= N statements and no_changed_test_reference = true (input: HunkMetrics.untestedChangedStatementMax).

tier0.text: Every changed line on both sides carries no non-trivia token (blank or comment-only), judged from a full-file createScanner pass with skipTrivia=false.
The hunk's base-side and head-side non-trivia token sequences (kind + text) are equal (whitespace/comment/formatting-only change).
Every changed line lies inside a top-level ImportDeclaration and the multiset of whitespace-normalised import declaration texts of that file is equal on both sides (pure reordering).
The hunk is in a test file.

manual.text: A file the hunk touches failed to parse (D35: non-empty parseDiagnostics) on either side.
An atom of the hunk intersects an ambiguous function in a production file.

tierAssignment.text: The first matching class wins: manual (any manual rule), then tier 2 (any tier-2 rule), then tier 0 (no tier-2 rule fires and any tier-0 rule holds), else tier 1. Manual wins over tier 0 and tier 2 wins over tier 0 (plan 8.2).

readingOrder.text: Tier 2 and manual hunks first, ordered together by tie key; then tier 1; then tier 0 (plan 8.2, D35).

guards.text: Tier-2 share (manual counted as tier 2) of all dev atoms
Tier-2 share (manual counted as tier 2) of all clean dev atoms, clean twins and near-misses pooled

selection.noValidCandidate: Publish 'no valid policy in the declared space' and stop before held-out.
